narrative.en:
This is your 1st stop at Buggy Start Point .

This is your 2nd stop at Water Birds Buggy Point. Here you will see Sambar Deer 1, Painted Stork, Blackbuck 1, Lion Tailed Macaque, Asiatic Black Bear 2, Hamadryas Baboon.

This is your 3rd stop at Rhinoceros Buggy Point. Here you will see Indian Rhinoceros (Greater One Horned Rhinoceros), Asiatic Black Bear 2, Sloth Bear, Brow antlered Deer (Sangai) 1.

This is your 4th stop at Lion Buggi Point. Here you will see Asiatic Lion 1, Stump tailed Macaque, Asian Palm Civet, Aquatic Birds Aviary, Rhesus Macaque 1.

This is your 5th stop at Elephant Buggy Point. Here you will see Indian Elephant, Asiatic Wild Dog (Dhole), Smooth coated Otter.

This is your 6th stop at White Tiger Buggy Point. Here you will see White Tiger, Indian Crested Porcupine, Asian Palm Civet, Indian Jackal, Indian Wolf.

This is your 7th stop at Royal Bengal Tiger Buggy Point. Here you will see Bengal Tiger 1, Reptile House, Siamese Crocodile, Marsh Crocodile 2, Common Ostrich, Emu.

This is your 8th stop at Buggy End Point .

narrative.en:
This is your 1st stop at Buggy Start Point .

This is your 2nd stop at Water Birds Buggy Point. Here you will see Painted Stork, Blackbuck 1, Lion Tailed Macaque, Asiatic Black Bear 2, Hamadryas Baboon, Sambar Deer 2.

This is your 3rd stop at Sambar Deer Buggy Point. Here you will see Blackbuck 1, Hog Deer, Blackbuck (Leucistic), Common Fox (Indian Fox), Gaur 2, Indian Star Tortoise, Blackbuck (Leucistic). You can also visit the cafeteria here.

This is your 4th stop at Small Cats Buggy Point. Here you will see Common Fox (Indian Fox), Gaur 2, Spotted Deer (Chital) 1, Brow antlered Deer (Sangai) 1, Indian Star Tortoise.

This is your 5th stop at Rhinoceros Buggy Point. Here you will see Indian Rhinoceros (Greater One Horned Rhinoceros), Asiatic Black Bear 2, Sloth Bear, Brow antlered Deer (Sangai) 1.

This is your 6th stop at Birds Buggy Point. Here you will see Blue and Gold Macaw, Red and Blue Macaw, Illiger's Macaw, Eclectus Parrot, Bare eyed Cockatoo, African Grey Parrot, Khalij Pheasant 2, Lady Amherst’s Pheasant, Golden Pheasant, Silver Pheasant 1, Grey Francolin, Black Partridge, Rose Ringed Parakeet, Indian Grey Hornbill, Red Jungle Fowl 1, Alexandrine Parakeet 1, Indian Peafowl 1, Indian Peafowl (Leucistic), Spotted Dove.

This is your 7th stop at Raptors Buggy Point. Here you will see Great Horned Owl, Striped Hyena, Black Kite, Brahminy Kite 1, Egyptian Vulture, Wild Boar.

This is your 8th stop at Hippopotamus Buggy Point. Here you will see Hippopotamus, Sika Deer, Chinkara , Wild Boar, Indian Peafowl 2, Asiatic Lion 2.

This is your 9th stop at Lion Buggi Point. Here you will see Asiatic Lion 1, Stump tailed Macaque, Asian Palm Civet, Aquatic Birds Aviary, Rhesus Macaque 1.

This is your 10th stop at Elephant Buggy Point. Here you will see Indian Elephant, Asiatic Wild Dog (Dhole), Smooth coated Otter.

This is your 11th stop at White Tiger Buggy Point. Here you will see White Tiger, Indian Crested Porcupine, Asian Palm Civet, Indian Jackal, Indian Wolf.

This is your 12th stop at Buggy End Point .
